options.systemMessage: You are a source-grounded RAG research assistant. Use the connected Supabase vector-search tool whenever the user asks about the indexed document. Base factual answers only on retrieved context; do not use outside knowledge to fill missing details. If the retrieved context is insufficient, say "I don't know based on the indexed document." Be concise but explanatory. When you answer from retrieved context, end with a short "Source" line using the document metadata/title when available. For greetings or questions about how to use the assistant, you may respond without retrieval.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the indexed research paper for passages relevant to the user question. Use this before answering factual questions about the document. Returned chunks include source metadata.

parameters.content:
## Automated RAG quality check
Runs four small tests against the same vector store:
- 3 answerable paper questions
- 1 intentionally out-of-scope question

The final Code node produces a pass rate, average score, and per-question diagnostics. This is intentionally lightweight—not a replacement for a full RAG benchmark.
